character_sheet: The Nightmare (the `pitch_black` registry) is a winged, many-toothed boss that comes in five sizes: a two-block body with two shoulders, a three-segment neck to a seven-piece head with two eyes, twenty-three teeth and a five-piece lower jaw, two wings of three spars, three membranes and three claws each, two three-piece legs on seven-piece clawed feet with a leg spike each, and a nine-segment forked tail with two points and six spikes (ModelPitchBlack.createBodyLayer, ModelPitchBlack.java:229-637). Its size tier (1 to 5, scale 0.5 to 4, PitchBlack.java:106-128) sets its stats — 125 to 1000 HP, 15 to 120 attack, 11 to 18 armour, 0.25 to 0.6 speed (:119-125, applySizeTierAttributes :265-296) — its hitbox (2.5 x 3.5 blocks times the scale, :299-307), its purple boss bar's name (:130-131, :292) and, in the model, the rate of every rhythm. Grounded (DATA_ACTIVITY 0) it wanders and looks about (:172-176) and takes off on a 1-in-10 tick with prey in sight (:461-471) or a 4-in-5 chance of a rare roll (tick :420-441); flying (activity 1) it steers itself between flight targets (:474-488, :516-528) and on a 1-in-8 tick hunts anything living in sight within 16 plus six scales of blocks except its own kind and eight listed allies (:489-511, :566-600), flying to two blocks above the target with the attacking flag up and biting within five blocks plus half the target's width plus the scale (doHurtTarget :365-401: the tier's attack, a knockback scaled by size; the Ender Dragon hit part-wise). It lands only on a rare roll with solid ground below and no prey (:420-437); hits are refused for 20 ticks and turn its flight on the attacker (hurt :531-543); its wings sound every 20 ticks (:406-412) and it heals 1 plus the scale on a 1-in-250 roll (:421). It spawns at night in the dark in the Chaos and Island biomes (chaos_biome.json, island_biome.json) — in Chaos never within 16 blocks of another, and above scale 1 only under a clear air pocket sized by its tier (checkSpawnRules :672-690) (chaos_biome.json, island_biome.json) and strews its loot by its size (:625-630). Read it as a bat-winged stalker: a heavy stride on the ground, a slow wide beat in the air, the forked tail sweeping.
size_notes: Drawn at the entity's own size scale — 0.5, 1, 2, 3 or 4 by the synced size tier (PitchBlackRenderer.java:42-43; shadow 1.25) on a 512x256 sheet (ModelPitchBlack.java:637); 2.0 x 3.0 block hitbox as registered (ModEntities.java:121-122), 2.5 x 3.5 times the scale live (PitchBlack.getDefaultDimensions :299-307). Every wing, leg and tail rate in the model is divided by the scale (the bigger the slower); the jaw's are not. The legs, wings and tail are chains the code positions segment by segment — key the joints, never the positions.

groups.name: gait
groups.axis: x, with the foot's slide (z) and lift (y)
groups.amplitude: on the ground (activity 0), x the walking speed, zero below a limbSwingAmount of 0.001: the foot (seven claw pieces) slides 12 x scale units fore-aft with the wave and lifts 6 x scale units on the forward half (sin > 0); the lower leg and its spike ride the foot and pitch pi x 0.18 = 0.565 rad (32 deg) about −0.61 / −0.785; the thigh and upper leg pitch the same 32 degrees about −0.576 / 0.977, placed 17 units up the lower leg; the right leg half a period behind; in flight (activity 1) the feet hang at a fixed height with the claws at −0.7, the legs following, and paddle 11 degrees while attacking
groups.plain: on the ground each leg strides as a planted foot that slides back and lifts forward with the leg pieces swinging above it, the right leg opposite the left; in the air the legs hang tucked, paddling a little when it attacks
groups.math: c = cos(t * 0.75 * 0.65 / scale), s = sin(same) (right: + pi); lclaw*.z = 7 + 12 scale * c * amount; lclaw*.y = s > 0 ? 21 - s * 6 scale * amount : 21; leftleg3 = the foot's position, xRot -0.61 + c * pi * 0.18 * amount; llegspike.xRot = -0.785 + the same; leftleg1.xRot = -0.576 + the same; leftleg2.xRot = 0.977 + the same (both placed 17 up the lower leg); in flight: p = attacking ? cos(t * 0.85 * 0.65 / scale) * 0.2 : 0; lclaw*.y = 9 + 30 p (right 9 - 30 p), lclaw*.xRot = -0.7 + p (right -0.7 - p); leftleg3.xRot = -0.61 + lclaw1.xRot; leftleg1/2.xRot = rest - lclaw1.xRot / 4

groups.name: wings
groups.amplitude: in flight (activity 1): pi x 0.24 = 0.754 rad (43 deg) about zero at 0.2925 / scale rad/tick; on the ground: pi x 0.02 = 0.063 rad (3.6 deg) about −pi/4 (folded) at 0.0325 / scale rad/tick; the root spar and membrane take the wave, the middle spar and membrane 5/3 of it, the tip spar and membrane 2x, the three claws 3/2, each placed at the end of the spar before (21 and 43 units); the right wing the negative

groups.name: tail
groups.amplitude: attacking: pi x 0.25 = 0.785 rad (45 deg) at 0.76 x 0.65 / scale rad/tick; not attacking: pi x 0.08 = 0.251 rad (14 deg) at 0.26 x 0.65 / scale; segment 1 takes half the wave, segments 2 to 4 the full wave an eighth of a period apart, the fork (segment 5) adds half the wave to segment 4, each fork adds another half per segment about ±0.174, and the points half again; the six spikes ride their segments; positions along the chain by 11 and 9 units

(0.76 / scale, 0.25) : (0.26 / scale, 0.08); tail1.yRot = cos(t * ts * 0.65) * pi * amp / 2; tail2 = cos(... - pi/4) * pi * amp; tail3 = cos(... - pi/2) * pi * amp; tail4 = cos(... - 3pi/4) * pi * amp; h = tail4's wave / 2; tail5 = tail4 + h; tail6 = 0.174 + tail5 + h; tail9 = tail6 + h; tailpoint1 = tail9 + h; tail7 = -0.174 + tail5 + h; tail8 = tail7 + h; tailpoint2 = tail8 + h; spikes = their segments
groups.phase: the attacking flag selects; the rate is divided by the size scale

behaviour: Every rhythm but the jaw's is divided by the size scale (ModelPitchBlack.java:653): a scale-4 Nightmare moves four times slower than a scale-1 one, a scale-0.5 twice faster.

On the ground (DATA_ACTIVITY 0, PitchBlack.java:93) one speed-scaled stride at 0.4875 / scale rad/tick: each foot — seven claw pieces moved as one — slides 12 x scale units back and forth and lifts 6 x scale on its forward half, the lower leg and its spike ride it and pitch 32 degrees, the thigh and upper piece swing the same above, the right leg half a period behind (:765-847). In the air the feet hang at a fixed height with the claws curled and, while attacking, paddle 11 degrees at 0.5525 / scale rad/tick (:848-904).

The wings beat 43 degrees at 0.2925 / scale rad/tick in flight, the middle spars 5/3 and the tips twice that, the claws 3/2, each placed at the end of the spar before; on the ground they hang folded at −45 degrees with a 3.6-degree stir (:658-698). The head turns 0.55 of the look yaw on the ground and only 0.2 in flight, the neck's last segment half of that, and the head pieces, eyes, upper teeth and jaw follow (:699-728).

The five-piece lower jaw and its ten teeth chomp 29 degrees at 0.5525 rad/tick (not scaled) while the synced DATA_ATTACKING byte is set (raised at :494 with prey in the hunt), and at rest one period in twenty on a per-entity latch (:729-760). The tail sweeps in a travelling wave along five segments and fans into two forks — 14 degrees at 0.169 / scale rad/tick at rest, 45 degrees at 0.494 / scale attacking (:905-955).

The body blocks, shoulders and the first two neck segments are static; the walk position plays no part beyond the speed. The takeoff and landing are flag flips (PitchBlack.java:436, :439, :467, :540), the bite is doHurtTarget (:365-401) from the hunt (:509-511) — none are animation events.

wishlist: in `fly`: the code beats the wings 43 degrees (ModelPitchBlack.java:658) but holds the body flat — add a body rise on the downstroke and let the forked tail trail; remember the beat slows with the size tier
in `walk`: the code's stride is a foot slide with a lift on the forward half and the leg pieces swinging above it (:765-847) — keep the heavy plant and add a body sway and a head bob
in `attack`: a diving bite with the jaw's 29-degree chomp (:730-731) and the feet reaching; the bite lands within five blocks plus half the target's width plus the scale (PitchBlack.java:492-511)
in `aggro_idle`: the steady chomp (:730-731) and the tail's fast 45-degree sweep (:905-907) made into a hover-and-stare
locked_bones_note: The design's section 6 ModelPitchBlack row (geckolib_migration_design.md:451): 'At scale 1: head1 [1.2,1] @1; body/body2 [1.8,1.8] @0.5; left/right segmented legs [0.6,1.4] @0.5; wing1/rwing1 [2,0.6] @0.25; tail1/tail5/tail9 [0.7,0.7] @0.25. Multiply part sizes from the authoritative discrete size tier.' head1, body, body2, wing1, rwing1, tail1, tail5 and tail9 resolve as written (ModelPitchBlack.createBodyLayer; tail9 is the left fork's second segment, ModelPitchBlack.java:932-934). 'left/right segmented legs' is not a bone name: taken as the three leg segments a side — leftleg1, leftleg2, leftleg3 and rightleg1, rightleg2, rightleg3 (the seven claw pieces a foot and the leg spikes stay visual). The sizes are the row's scale-1 values; the profile multiplies them by the synced size tier's scale (PitchBlack.getPitchBlackScale :240-242), which the row calls the scale-path proof case.
formulas: `ModelPitchBlack.poseFrom` (ModelPitchBlack.java:647-956; orig ModelPitchBlack.java:738-1139 in `render` (func_78088_a, :730-1140; func_78087_a at :1148-1150 is a bare super call), wingspeed 0.65 from `new ModelPitchBlack(0.65f)` in orig ClientProxyOreSpawn.java:460 - the port's WINGSPEED; every rhythm divided by the entity's size tier and the claw amplitudes multiplied by it): with any activity the wing angle is the cosine of the age in ticks times 0.45 times the wingspeed over the size tier, times pi, times 0.24; else -0.7853982 plus the cosine of the age times 0.05 times the wingspeed over the size tier, times pi, times 0.02. The first wing and membrane roll by it, the second wing and membrane by five thirds of it, placed 21 units from the first wing's pivot along the cosine (x) and sine (y) of its roll, the third wing and membrane by twice it, placed 43 units on from the second the same way, and the three wing claws by three halves of it at the third wing's place; the right wing mirrors it. The look yaw is taken modulo 360 and times 0.2 with any activity, else 0.55: the third neck ring yaws by half of it in radians, the seven head parts, five jaws, twenty-three teeth and two eyes by it. Attacking, the jaw angle is the cosine of the age times 0.85 times the wingspeed, times pi, times 0.16, plus 0.5; not attacking, the phase of the age times 0.7 times the wingspeed modulo two pi is compared with the render scratch's last phase - on a wrap the chomp bit is cleared and set with one chance in twenty from the entity's random - and the angle is the sine of the age times 0.85 times the wingspeed, times pi, times 0.16, plus 0.5 while the bit is set, else 0.19634955. The five jaws and eleven of the teeth pitch by it. While the activity is 0: while the walking speed is above a thousandth the left leg's swing is the cosine of the age times 0.75 times the wingspeed over the size tier and its lift the sine of the same, else 0; while the lift is positive the seven left claws rise 6 times the size tier times the lift times the walking speed above 21, else sit at 21, and are placed at 7 plus 12 times the size tier times the swing times the walking speed in z; the lower leg and its spike take the claws' place, the lower leg pitching -0.61, the spike -0.785, the upper leg -0.576 and the thigh 0.977, each plus the swing times pi times 0.18 times the walking speed; the thigh and upper leg sit 17 units up the lower leg's pitch plus half the lift, and the claws' pitch is reset to 0; the right leg the same a half turn behind. With any activity the claws tuck at z 7 and y 9 plus (left) or minus (right) 30 times the swing, curled -0.7 plus or minus it, where the swing is the cosine of the age times 0.85 times the wingspeed over the size tier, times 0.2 while attacking, else 0; the lower legs and spikes follow the claws, the lower leg pitching -0.61 plus the curl and the spike -0.785 plus it, the upper leg -0.576 and the thigh 0.977 less a quarter of it, 17 units up the lower leg's pitch. The tail speed is 0.76 over the size tier and the amplitude 0.25 attacking, else 0.26 over the size tier and 0.08: the first tail part yaws by half the cosine of the age times the tail speed times the wingspeed, times pi, times the amplitude; the second, third and fourth by that cosine lagged 0.7853982, twice and three times that, times pi, times the amplitude, placed 11, 9 and 9 units from the part before along the cosine (z) and sine (x) of its yaw (the second a unit to the left); the fifth is placed 9 units on and yaws by the fourth's yaw plus half the three-times-lagged cosine, then the tail forks: the sixth part yaws 0.174 more, the ninth and the first point 9 units on adding that half again, the seventh -0.174 more, the eighth and the second point the same, the six tail spikes riding their parts. The walk position and the look pitch play no part. The GeckoLib hook is the same (PitchBlackGeoReplacement.applyCustomAnimations).
